label: Veo 3.1 Fast
exclusive: image_urls means either frames (FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO: 1 = first, 2 = first+last) or 1-3 reference images (REFERENCE_2_VIDEO), never both; generation_type picks which, and is auto-detected if omitted.
notes: Top-level model is always 'veo-3-1'; tier goes in input.model (veo3_fast default | veo3_lite | veo3). generation_type values: TEXT_2_VIDEO, FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO, REFERENCE_2_VIDEO. REFERENCE_2_VIDEO: 1-3 images, duration 8 only, fast/lite only, 16:9 & 9:16. 'Auto' aspect center-crops to whichever of 16:9/9:16 the image is closer to. Audio ships by default (no toggle; may be suppressed for sensitive scenes). For 1080p/4k the URL is in resultJson.data.result_urls (720p in data.origin_urls). enable_fallback is deprecated - do not send.

label: Veo 3.1 Lite
exclusive: image_urls means either frames (1 = first, 2 = first+last) or 1-3 reference images (REFERENCE_2_VIDEO), never both.
notes: Same endpoint as Veo 3.1 Fast with input.model=veo3_lite. REFERENCE_2_VIDEO supported (8s only).

label: Veo 3.1 Quality
exclusive: No reference mode on Quality (REFERENCE_2_VIDEO is fast/lite only); image_urls is 1 first frame or first+last.
notes: input.model=veo3 is the Quality tier. Use generation_type TEXT_2_VIDEO or FIRST_AND_LAST_FRAMES_2_VIDEO only.

label: Runway (Gen video)
exclusive: Single optional image only. aspect_ratio is required for text-only and ignored (image decides) when image_url is sent.
notes: 10s cannot be 1080p and 1080p cannot be 10s. Prompt max 1800 chars. image_url is described as a 'reference image ... animating or extending this image' (acts as the start image). The doc says callBackUrl is 'Required for all video generation requests' although the schema only requires model+input; send one. Separate extend and Aleph endpoints exist (not covered).

label: Kling 3.0

ref_videos.max_unit: elements; a video element holds exactly 1 video (MP4/MOV, >=3s; trimmed segment start_time..end_time 3000-8000 ms)

exclusive: Max 3 elements per task. An element is either 2-4 images or 1 video (not mixed). Elements can be combined with image_urls frames. With multi_shots=true only the first frame (image_urls[0]) is supported - no last frame.
notes: Resolution comes from mode x aspect (std 1280x720, pro 1920x1080, 4K 3840x2160 for 16:9). aspect_ratio optional when image_urls given (follows first frame); set it explicitly for text-to-video. prompt is required when multi_shots=false (max 2500); with multi_shots=true use multi_prompt (up to 5 shots, each 1-12s, <=500 chars) and set duration to the shot total. Sound costs more in std/pro.

label: Kling 3.0 Omni Image to Video

ref_videos.max_unit: elements; a video character element holds exactly 1 video, trimmed 3000-8000 ms via start_time/end_time

exclusive: image_urls must be exactly 1 (first frame) or exactly 2 (first + last). customize_multi_shots and prefer_multi_shots cannot both be true. Elements (max 3) may accompany the frames.
notes: Images JPG/JPEG/PNG <=50MB, >=300px, aspect 0.4-2.5. 16:9/9:16/1:1 only allowed with customize_multi_shots=true (multi_prompt 1-6 shots, each 1-12s, total <=15s). Doc recommends sending audio explicitly. Prompt max 3072.

label: Kling 3.0 Omni Text to Video

ref_images.max_unit: multi-image subjects (each 2-4 images); max 4 when video subjects are also used

exclusive: No frames. Elements: only multi-image subjects <=7; only video subjects <=3; mixed = video <=3 and multi-image <=4. customize_multi_shots and prefer_multi_shots cannot both be true.
notes: Text-to-video that still accepts subject elements (so it can do character-consistent t2v). Prompt 1-3072 chars. multi_prompt up to 6 shots, each 1-12s, total <=15.

label: Kling 3.0 Omni Reference to Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: not documented for image_urls; elements use @<name>
ref_images.note: <=7 combined with multi-image elements when no video; <=4 when a reference video is present or video-character elements are used

ref_videos.note: exactly 1 video, 3-15.5s, MP4/MOV <=200MB, 700-4553 px sides, aspect 0.4-2, 24-60fps

exclusive: Three variants: (a) images only, (b) video only (aspect_ratio must be 'auto', no duration field, audio must be false), (c) video + images (audio false). With a reference video, video-character elements cannot be combined with multi-image elements or reference images, and elements are unavailable when customize_multi_shots=false.

audio.required: required when video_urls is sent (must be false)

audio_out: toggle (no audio when a video is provided)
notes: Images JPG/JPEG/PNG <=50MB, >=300px, aspect 0.4-2.5. 'auto' aspect only valid in the video-only variant.

label: Kling V3 Turbo Image to Video
notes: Audio track always included, cannot be turned off. image_urls has no maxItems in schema but is described as 'URL of the image'; send 1. JPEG/PNG <=10MB. Prompt max 2500.

label: Kling V3 Turbo Text to Video
notes: Audio always on.

label: Kling 2.6 Image to Video
notes: Enabling sound doubles the price. JPEG/PNG only, <=10MB. Prompt max 2500. No aspect/resolution fields.

label: Kling 2.6 Text to Video
notes: Sound doubles the price.

label: Kling V2.5 Turbo Image to Video Pro
notes: Output always has an audio track (no toggle). negative_prompt max 2496, cfg_scale 0-1 (default 0.5). JPEG/PNG <=10MB.

label: Kling V2.5 Turbo Text to Video Pro
notes: Audio always on.

label: Kling V2.1 Pro
notes: kie has no v2.1 Pro/Standard text-to-video; the only v2.1 t2v is the Master tier (kling/v2-1-master-text-to-video). negative_prompt max 500.

label: Kling V2.1 Standard
exclusive: First frame only (no tail_image_url on Standard).
notes: Only v2.1 t2v on kie is the Master tier.

label: Kling V2.1 Master Text to Video
notes: Master tier (also has kling/v2-1-master-image-to-video, not covered here).

label: Seedance 2.0

ref_images.prompt_syntax: @image1 / @Image1 (kie.ai marketing examples, not in API spec)

exclusive: First frame / first+last frames / multimodal reference are three mutually exclusive scenarios: never combine first_frame_url or last_frame_url with any reference_* field.
notes: Prompt 3-20000 chars (described as required though not in the schema's required list). URLs may be asset://{assetId}. Images jpeg/png/webp/bmp/tiff/gif, aspect 0.4-2.5, 300-6000px, <30MB. 4k output is H.265/HEVC. With reference videos billing = lower per-second price x (ref video seconds + output seconds). return_last_frame is marked deprecated here (2.5 has it live). To get frame+reference behaviour, use references and say in the prompt which image is the first/last frame.

label: Seedance 2.0 Fast
exclusive: First frame / first+last / multimodal reference are mutually exclusive; do not combine first_frame_url/last_frame_url with any reference_* field.
notes: Same input shape as Seedance 2.0 but only 480p/720p. asset:// URLs accepted.

label: Seedance 2.5
exclusive: Image-to-video (first frame), first+last frames, and multimodal reference (images/videos/audio) are three mutually exclusive scenarios; last_frame_url cannot be sent without first_frame_url.
notes: No required input fields; prompt max 20480. Images jpeg/png/webp, aspect 0.4-2.5, 300-6000px, <30MB. Reference videos add billable seconds (ref seconds + output seconds); reference images/audio do not. duration=-1 lets the model choose (billed on actual). asset:// URLs accepted.

label: Seedance 2.0 Mini
exclusive: Same three mutually exclusive scenarios as Seedance 2.0.
notes: Not in the current catalog; listed because it is the cheapest member of the Seedance 2 family with the same multimodal inputs. No return_last_frame field.

label: Seedance 1.5 Pro
notes: The API spec only says 'Accepts 0-2 images'; that index 1 is the last frame comes from the kie.ai/seedance-1-5-pro page ('I2V supports first and last frame control'). Audio doubles the per-second price. Images jpeg/png/webp <=10MB. Prompt 3-20000.

label: Seedance V1 Pro Image to Video
exclusive: First frame only (V1 Pro has no end_image_url; V1 Lite does).
notes: seed -1 = random. Prompt max 10000.

label: Seedance V1 Pro Text to Video
Seedance V1 Lite Image to Video
notes: end_image_url = last frame (jpeg/png/webp <=10MB).

label: Seedance V1 Lite Text to Video
notes: Aspect list has 9:21 (not 21:9 like V1 Pro).

label: Hailuo 2.3 Pro Image to Video
notes: 10s is not supported at 1080P. No Hailuo 2.3 text-to-video id exists on kie (docs 404); nearest text-only option is hailuo/02-text-to-video-pro or -standard. Prompt max 5000.

label: Hailuo 2.3 Standard Image to Video
notes: Same schema as 2.3 Pro. 10s not at 1080P. No 2.3 t2v id; nearest is hailuo/02-text-to-video-standard.

label: Hailuo 02 Standard Image to Video
notes: Prompt max 1500. hailuo/02-image-to-video-pro also exists (1080p ~6s fixed, image_url + end_image_url; not in catalog).

label: Hailuo 02 Standard Text to Video
notes: Output fixed at 768P; no aspect or resolution field. Prompt max 1500.

label: Hailuo 02 Pro Text to Video
notes: Doc overview: 'Output: 1080p, about 6 seconds, no audio.' No duration/resolution/aspect fields at all. Prompt max 1500.

label: MiniMax H3 Image to Video
exclusive: Either first_frame_url or last_frame_url must be provided (a last frame alone is allowed); no reference inputs on this id.
notes: Stereo audio always generated (cannot be turned off); describe dialogue/music in prompt. Images JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP/HEIC/HEIF <=30MB, 256-5760px, aspect 0.4-2.5; URL must be http(s):// or oss://. Prompt 1-7000. kie playground example prompt: 'Use Image 1 as the exact opening frame and Image 2 as the exact ending frame'.

label: MiniMax H3 Text to Video
notes: Audio always on.

label: MiniMax H3 Reference to Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: kie playground example uses 'Video 1', 'Image 2', 'Audio 3' (numbering scheme not documented; example suggests one running index across media types)

ref_audio.note: each 2-15s wav/mp3 <=15MB; cannot be used alone

exclusive: At least one reference image or reference video is required; reference audio must accompany an image or video. No frame fields.
notes: Billing: reference-video seconds are added to output seconds; first 5 reference images free, extra images cost more; reference audio free. Can also do video restyle (reference video only + prompt).

label: Wan 3.0 Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: Image1, Image2 ... in array order (marketing example also writes 'Image1 @Image1')

ref_videos.note: each 1-15s, mp4/mov <=100MB, 240-4096px; also input video seconds + duration <= 30; prompt Video1, Video2

ref_audio.note: each 1-15s, wav/mp3 <=15MB; may be the only media input; prompt Audio1

exclusive: first_frame_url/last_frame_url cannot be combined with any reference_*_urls (incl. file/link); last frame needs a first frame; reference_file_urls and reference_link_urls are mutually exclusive.
notes: Prompt required for text-to-video (max 20000). Frame/reference images: JPEG/PNG(no transparency)/BMP/WEBP, 240-8000px, aspect <=8:1, <=20MB. Resolution values are uppercase P. Billing = output seconds + reference-video seconds.

label: Wan 3.0 Video Prime
exclusive: Same as wan/3-0-video: frames vs reference_* are exclusive; file vs link exclusive; file/link not with frames.
notes: Identical schema to wan/3-0-video; doc calls Prime the 'high-speed model'.

label: Wan 2.7 Image to Video

ref_videos.note: video continuation input, not a reference

exclusive: Three modes: first frame, first+last frame, or video continuation (first_clip_url). At least one of first_frame_url or first_clip_url is required.
notes: For continuation, duration is the total length including the input clip, and the whole length is billed. Doc example pairs driving_audio_url with a first frame. Prompt max 5000.

label: Wan 2.7 Text to Video
notes: Aspect field is named 'ratio' here, not aspect_ratio.

label: Wan 2.7 Reference to Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: 'Image 1', 'image 2' (doc example: 'Image 1 is eating, while video 1 and image 2 are singing')

ref_audio.note: voice timbre, wav/mp3 1-10s <=15MB; overrides audio inside reference_video

exclusive: At least one of reference_image / reference_video; total images+videos <= 5. first_frame CAN be combined with references (aspect_ratio is then ignored).
notes: reference_image/reference_video are arrays despite singular names; first_frame is a single string.

label: Wan 2.6 Image to Video
notes: Output keeps input aspect and includes generated audio (no toggle). Image >=256x256, jpeg/png/webp <=10MB. Prompt 2-5000.

label: Wan 2.6 Text to Video
notes: Output is always 16:9 with generated audio; portrait not available, no aspect field. Also the t2v fallback for wan/2-6-flash-image-to-video (no flash t2v exists).

label: Wan 2.6 Video to Video (reference)
exclusive: Reference videos only (the subject of the video(s) is placed in the scene the prompt describes).
notes: Despite the name this is subject-reference generation, not restyling. Output includes generated audio.

label: Wan 2.6 Flash Image to Video
notes: No flash text-to-video id; t2v sibling given is the non-flash wan/2-6-text-to-video. Prompt 2-1500.

label: Wan 2.6 Flash Video to Video (reference)
notes: Subject of reference video(s) in a prompt-described scene.

label: Wan 2.5 Image to Video
notes: Prompt max 800 chars (short!). No audio field, but the doc's example prompts describe dialogue and ambient audio, implying audio is generated.

label: Wan 2.5 Text to Video
notes: Prompt max 800.

label: Grok Imagine Image to Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: @image1 / @image(n) followed by a space, e.g. '@image1 a sunset over the ocean'

exclusive: image_urls and task_id (+index, a previous grok-imagine/text-to-image result) must not be used together. Only 1 image allowed at 1080p. Spicy mode not available with external image_urls.
notes: 1 image = single-image mode (output takes the image's size; aspect_ratio ignored); 2-7 images = multi-image reference mode where aspect_ratio applies. The doc calls images 'reference' and never literally says 'first frame'. Audio track always generated (prompt dialogue is spoken). Duration is a string here. Prompt max 5000, optional.

label: Grok Imagine Text to Video
notes: Default aspect is 2:3 (portrait). Schema says duration is a number but the doc example sends "6" as a string.

label: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Preview

ref_images.prompt_syntax: not documented for this id (grok-imagine/image-to-video uses @image1)

exclusive: Only 1 image allowed at 1080p. aspect_ratio is ignored with a single image.
notes: Model string has no slash. Doc calls it a text-to-video endpoint with optional images (up to 7, 20MB each). Audio always on. Prompt max 4096.

label: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash

ref_images.note: slots: images + video_list x2 + character slots <= 7

ref_audio.note: IDs from POST /api/v1/omni/audio/create (gemini-omni-audio: registers a preset voice, free, synchronous) - not audio file URLs

exclusive: first_frame_url cannot be combined with image_urls, audio_ids, video_list or character_ids (frames mode vs reference mode); last_frame_url needs first_frame_url.
other_useful: character_ids (<=3, from POST /api/v1/omni/character/create; 1 slot each, 2 if portrait+body)
notes: duration is ignored when video_list is given (model decides length). Images <=20MB. Prompt max 20000. Helper endpoints gemini-omni-audio and gemini-omni-character are free and return IDs.

label: Gemini Omni Video

ref_images.note: slots: images + video x2 + character slots <= 7

exclusive: No first/last frame fields on this id; all inputs are references sharing a 7-slot budget.
notes: Model string has no 'google/' prefix. Older sibling of google/gemini-omni-flash-1-1 without frame support and without 360p. duration ignored when a video is supplied.

label: PixVerse V6 Image to Video
exclusive: Without template_id send exactly 1 image (first frame). With template_id send 1 or 2 images as the template's effect_type requires, and do not send duration.
notes: For first+last frames use pixverse-v6/transition. Images <=20MB, http/https/oss. Prompt 3-5000. Audio costs more.

label: PixVerse V6 Transition (first + last frame)
notes: PixVerse's first+last-frame model is a separate id.

label: PixVerse V6 Reference to Video
exclusive: Images only, passed as objects (not a plain URL list).
notes: Doc example omits type/ref_name, so they appear optional.

label: HappyHorse 1.1 Image to Video
notes: Output keeps input image aspect. Image >=300px, aspect 1:2.5-2.5:1, <=20MB. Prompt optional (<=5000 chars, 2500 Chinese). No seed on 1.1 (1.0 had seed).

label: HappyHorse 1.1 Reference to Video

ref_images.prompt_syntax: [Image 1], [Image 2] in array order, e.g. 'the woman in a red qipao in [Image 1]'

notes: Field is singular 'reference_image' but it is an array. Images shortest side >=400px (720p+ recommended), <=20MB. HappyHorse 1.0 (happyhorse/reference-to-video) uses 'character1, character2' prompt syntax instead.
